# `time_diff`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
time_diff(unit, start, end)
```

Gets the difference between the times in the specified units.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- time_diff, example 1
> SELECT time_diff('HOUR', TIME'20:30:29', TIME'21:30:28');
0
```

```sql
-- time_diff, example 2
> SELECT time_diff('HOUR', TIME'20:30:29', TIME'21:30:29');
1
```

```sql
-- time_diff, example 3
> SELECT time_diff('HOUR', TIME'20:30:29', TIME'12:00:00');
-8
```
